title: Senior Technical Product Owner – Enterprise Integrations
jd_text: Job Posting: Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in. The Senior Technical Product Owner - Enterprise Integrations serves as the strategic liaison between business customers and Agile delivery teams, ensuring product development aligns with business goals, enterprise priorities, and long-term product vision. This role is responsible for defining product direction, managing priorities, and driving delivery of high-value solutions that meet customer and business needs. The Senior Product Owner combines strong product management expertise, business sense, and technical understanding to guide multi-functional teams through the full product lifecycle. This individual works closely with stakeholders, architects, business systems analysts, developers, and QA teams to translate complex needs into actionable roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and successful product outcomes. This role drives product strategy and execution for initiatives with significant business and operational impact, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and delivering measurable value. The individual influences prioritization and investment decisions across product and technology teams, helping to focus efforts on the highest-impact opportunities. They play a key role in strengthening alignment with business partners, improving delivery quality, and boosting overall product value realization. Additionally, this position supports broader enterprise transformation efforts through clear product direction and disciplined, outcomes-focused execution. Location: This role is approved to be either Remote within the United States or Hybrid for associates in Newport News, VA, in accordance with company policy. Duties and Responsibilities: Product Strategy and Vision Define and communicate product vision, goals, and roadmap aligned to business strategy. Partner with internal customers to understand business needs, opportunities, and priorities. Evaluate business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility to shape product direction. Lead product discovery, roadmap planning, and prioritization efforts across initiatives. Ensure product investments support both near-term delivery goals and long-term strategic outcomes. Backlog and Delivery Management Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring items are prioritized based on business value, urgency, dependencies, and effort. Translate business needs into epics, features, and clearly defined requirements for delivery teams. Provide direction and clarification to Agile teams throughout the development lifecycle. Partner with Business Systems Analysts and technical teams to ensure requirements are actionable and complete. Reprioritize backlog items as needed to respond to changing business needs or market conditions. Ensure delivery remains aligned to scope, timeline, budget, and quality expectations. Stakeholder Management Build strong relationships with business partners, leadership, and delivery teams. Facilitate alignment across customers on priorities, scope, and expected outcomes. Communicate product updates, risks, dependencies, and achievements clearly and effectively. Drive decision-making and resolve conflicts or ambiguity related to requirements, scope, or priorities. Serve as the main point of contact for business collaborators throughout the product lifecycle. Multi-Functional Leadership Lead collaboration across business, architecture, engineering, QA, UX, and support teams. Ensure teams understand the “why” behind product priorities and business outcomes. Support Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Provide leadership on sophisticated initiatives involving multiple teams, systems, or business areas. Promote continuous improvement in product processes, team collaboration, and delivery effectiveness. Product Performance and Continuous Improvement Monitor product progress, outcomes, and adoption using dashboards, important metrics, and collaborator feedback. Evaluate delivered features to ensure they align with business goals and customer expectations. Find opportunities for optimization, innovation, and future improvements. Stay informed on industry trends, new technologies, and guidelines in product management and Agile delivery. Duties and Responsibilities: Develop and maintain product roadmaps for assigned business capabilities or platforms. Work with business customers to identify needs, define outcomes, and prioritize initiatives. Partner with delivery teams to ensure requirements are understood and implementation aligns with intended business value. Drive backlog refinement and ensure readiness for sprint planning and execution. Track progress, manage dependencies, and communicate updates to collaborators and leadership. Supervise product performance and recommend enhancements based on data, feedback, and business priorities. Support business case development, funding discussions, and strategic planning for future initiatives. Champion a customer-focused approach centered on delivering meaningful results. Qualifications: Minimum of 6+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related role within Agile software delivery environments. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or an equivalent area preferred. Technical knowledge of backend integrations, API, MongoDB and Java. Experience in enterprise or large-scale backend integration product environments. Experience working with business process transformation, customer-facing platforms, or internal enterprise systems. Scrum Product Owner, or related Agile/Product certification is a plus. Demonstrable experience owning product roadmaps, managing backlogs, and delivering technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Demonstrated experience leading multi-functional teams and influencing customers across business and IT functions. Good experience applying Agile methodologies, especially Scrum. Ability to define strategy while also managing tactical execution details. Experience partnering with senior leaders to shape vision, manage priorities, and deliver sophisticated initiatives. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Solid understanding of product ownership principles, Agile delivery, and software development lifecycle practices. Ability to translate business strategy into product roadmaps and actionable requirements. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Strong organizational and prioritization skills with proficiency in managing multiple initiatives simultaneously. Ability to build credibility and influence across teams and leadership levels. Comfortable working in both technical and business environments. Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Power BI, and Microsoft Office applications. Demonstrates a solid grasp of system integrations, business processes, and enterprise application delivery. Problem Solving Analyzes sophisticated business and technology challenges to define practical, scalable solutions. Balances contending priorities, customer expectations, and delivery constraints. Use sound judgment to make decisions in ambiguous or evolving environments. Adjust plans and priorities as new information, risks, or business needs emerge. At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more! #LI-REMOTE - Pay Range: - Actual pay rate may vary depending upon location. title: Senior Operations Manager
jd_text: Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year. We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own Vendor Performance Management: Run the weekly performance cadence across all fulfillment vendors: scorecard reviews, follow-ups, and corrective action plans; and hold partners accountable to SLAs with persistence and professionalism. - Manage Partner Relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of fulfillment vendors: own the recurring meeting cadence, lead business reviews, advocate for Vetcove externally, and keep relationships strong through the ups and downs of operational performance. - Analyze at Scale: Interrogate large datasets (SQL, Excel, BI tools) to identify root causes, quantify operational impact, and build the case for process and integration changes. Defend your conclusions with data. - Partner with Product & Engineering: Translate recurring operational failure modes into integration and fulfillment improvements; write clear requirements, drive prioritization, and follow through until fixes ship and the metrics move. - Operationalize New Initiatives: Take run-state ownership of newly launched programs: build the SOPs, own the KPIs, and make the operational decisions that keep them healthy at scale. - Build Operational Rigor: Author and maintain SOPs, escalation paths, and process documentation that make our vendor operations consistent, auditable, and scalable as the platform grows. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5-8 years of experience in operations, program management, marketplace/ecommerce operations, or supply chain – ideally in roles where you were accountable for external partner performance. - A documented record of relentless follow-through: you chase answers across organizations, escalate when needed, never let a thread die, and deliver on time without being reminded. - Strong analytical skills: proficiency in SQL (or demonstrated equivalent), advanced Excel/Sheets, and comfort drawing defensible conclusions from large, messy datasets. - Exceptional attention to detail: you notice the mismatched count, the silent data gap, the SLA miss buried in an average. - Experience managing vendor or partner relationships end to end; serving as a partner’s main point of contact, and balancing relationship-building with direct, constructive accountability conversations. - Excellent written communication and the ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams. - Self-directed and highly organized in a fully remote environment. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in ecommerce fulfillment, 3PL, pharmacy, or distribution operations. - Familiarity with BI/analytics tools (e.g., Hex, Looker, Tableau) and building or maintaining operational dashboards. - Background in animal health, healthcare, or another regulated fulfillment category. BENEFITS (FULL TIME ROLES) - 100% remote within the USA - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Automatic 401k contribution - Employee referral program - At home office set up - Bi-annual company retreats - Open vacation policy - Equity - Monthly team events The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $100,000/year -$150,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. For Colorado, the salary range is: $115,000 - $140,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. This salary range is a good faith estimate of what Vetcove may pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, and experience. The range reflects the base hourly rate or annual compensation (as applicable), and does not include bonus, equity or other incentives. In addition to base compensation, Vetcove offers a comprehensive benefits package. Please refer to the “Benefits (Full Time Roles)” section above for more details. To apply, please submit your application through Vetcove’s Careers Page. The application deadline is on an ongoing basis. Please note we are unable to sponsor work visas at this time. Attention all job seekers! We want to ensure that you’re well-informed about a serious matter affecting the job market. It has come to our attention that scammers are operating in the industry, impersonating employees and attempting to deceive savvy applicants like you. Here’s what you need to know: 1. Our job listings are exclusively available on official sites (our careers page, LinkedIn, BuiltIn, and Indeed). Be cautious of other sources claiming to represent us or any organization that you’re interested in. Stay on the lookout! 2. Authentic communications from our company will only come through verified email addresses and phone numbers. If you receive unexpected messages or calls, exercise caution and verify their authenticity. Don’t let scammers catch you off guard! 3. It's essential to independently verify the legitimacy of any job postings you come across. Visit our official careers page to confirm the validity of any openings. Stay proactive and protect yourself! 4. Remember that during the application process, we will never request sensitive personal or financial information from you. Be wary of anyone asking for such information. Keep your personal data secure! 5. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or encounter suspicious individuals, please report it immediately to our recruiting department. By working together, we can combat these scams and keep the job market safer for everyone. We understand the importance of your job search and want to ensure your experience is positive and secure. Always exercise caution and stay scam-smart! Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Vetcove is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants in accordance with all applicable laws and regulations. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know and we will make every effort to accommodate your needs.

title: Senior Order to Cash Operations Manager
jd_text: ABOUT ZIP Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. YOUR ROLE As a Senior Order to Cash (OTC) Operations Manager at Zip, you will own and scale the end-to-end OTC function for recurring subscriptions and consumption revenue models. You will lead cross-functional initiatives and work directly with senior leadership to drive operational transformation, optimize cash flow, and build OTC system architecture for Zip’s future growth. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with broad exposure across Finance, Sales, Deal Desk, Product, and Engineering. The ideal candidate is an experienced operator and strong day-to-day executor who would rather build than maintain, and who is comfortable designing and deploying automation and AI tools to support Zip’s revenue growth. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own the order to cash lifecycle end to end, from order creation through invoicing, collections, and cash application, ensuring accuracy, timely delivery, and adherence to contractual terms. - Drive customer collections: oversee dunning processes, monitor AR aging, and conduct direct outreach to customers with past-due accounts, working with Sales and Customer Success to resolve disputes and escalations. - Lead new billing and revenue system implementations, driving accounting requirements and keeping cross-functional stakeholders aligned on scope and timing. - Identify and deploy automation and AI-based workflows across invoicing and collections to reduce process cycle times. - Collaborate with GTM, Deal Desk, and Product on new SKU launches and validate that billing and accounting systems are ready before the launch date. - Manage the month-end close for bookings and billings, working in lockstep with Deal Strategy and Operations teams to ensure seamless handoff to Revenue Accounting. - Partner with Engineering and Product to ensure usage data is captured and reported into our billing systems accurately. - Proactively monitor and implement strategies to maintain strong collections, optimize cash flow and minimize bad debt exposure. - Serve as the primary point of contact for AR and billing external audit matters. - Develop documentation, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the order-to-cash function. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Required - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. CPA is a plus. - 8+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, revenue accounting, or order-to-cash, including time at a high-growth technology company. - Experience managing hybrid revenue models (recurring subscription + consumption). - Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for reconciliation and data analysis. - Familiarity using Snowflake queries for data retrieval and analysis; SQL proficiency is a plus. - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. - Working knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and application to billing. - Experience building AI-driven workflows involving multiple data sources and/or multiple system integration points. - Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work while owning strategic initiatives. - Track record of building or overhauling finance processes and systems, with sound judgment on what to build now and what to defer. - Familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, and modern billing and collections tooling. The salary range for this role is $145,000 - $210,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise. PERKS & BENEFITS At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. - 📈 Start-up equity - 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options - 🌴 Flexible PTO - 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership - 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours - 💻 Home office stipend - 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement - 🍼 Paid parental leave - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend - 💸 401k plan - 🤖 Unlimited AI token usage We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Project Manager (Product Development & Technology Delivery)
jd_text: Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At Ferrovial , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Listed on two major stock markets: Nasdaq - 100 Index (US) and IBEX 35 (Spain), we are also member of the Dow Jones Sustainability Index and FTSE4Good. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy. Cintra is the highways business unit of Ferrovial, one of the world’s leading infrastructure operators committed to developing sustainable solutions. Today, its portfolio includes nearly 1,200 miles of managed highways globally, representing a total global investment in roadway improvements of over $24.8 billion. We provide the maximum value in each project, managing all phases of the life cycle of our state-of-the-art infrastructure assets, such as the 407 ETR in Canada, the Managed Lanes LBJ and NTE in Texas, I-77 in North Carolina, I-66 in Virginia and our projects in Europe, South America, and India. Why Ferrovial? Global presence, local impact : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference. Collaborative excellence : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued. Inclusive Culture: Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation. Career growth : Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth. Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health. Productivity tools : Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency. Job Description: About the Role: We are seeking an experienced and highly driven professional to lead the end-to-end development, launch, scaling, and operationalization of innovative technology products that require significant software development and hardware integration. The Project Manager serves as the primary leader responsible for transforming business concepts into market-ready solutions, overseeing the entire product lifecycle from business case development and roadmap definition through design, development, deployment, and ongoing operations. The successful candidate will combine strong project and program management capabilities with a deep understanding of software engineering practices, systems integration, and hardware-enabled solutions. They will effectively bridge business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, vendors, and operations organizations to ensure successful delivery of complex technology products. Key responsibilities: Product Strategy & Planning Lead the translation of business opportunities into executable product development programs . Define product vision, roadmap, business objectives , success metrics, and launch strategies. Develop and manage business cases, investment plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements. Collaborate with executive leadership to align product initiatives with strategic business goals. Program & Project Leadership Own the end-to-end delivery of complex technology products from concept through commercialization. Manage cross-functional teams including product managers, software engineers, hardware engineers, quality assurance, operations, and external vendors. Establish and maintain project governance, risk management, reporting, and decision-making processes. Monitor scope, schedule, budget, dependencies, and resource utilization . Software Development Management Possess a detailed understanding of modern software development methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, cybersecurity, and quality assurance practices. Partner closely with development teams to evaluate technical solutions, development plans, architecture decisions, and release strategies. Ensure product requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and successfully translated into technical deliverables. Identify and mitigate technical risks and delivery challenges. Hardware & Systems Integration Oversee integration of hardware, devices, sensors, IoT components, communications infrastructure, and third-party systems. Coordinate validation, testing, interoperability, performance verification, and deployment readiness activities. Ensure seamless integration between physical infrastructure and software platforms. Manage vendor relationships and technical integration partners. Product Launch & Scaling Develop and execute go-to-market and deployment strategies. Lead pilot programs, customer acceptance testing, launch readiness reviews, and production deployments. Define operational support models and transition products into sustainable operations. Drive continuous improvement, product evolution, and scalability initiatives. Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary liaison between business leadership and technical teams. Communicate program status, key decisions, risks, and mitigation plans to executive stakeholders. Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities. Facilitate strategic and technical decision-making processes. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in engineering , Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in product development, technology program management, or related leadership roles in the transportation industry . Demonstrated success delivering complex products involving both software development and hardware integration. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, system architecture, cloud platforms, integration patterns, and DevOps practices. Experience leading cross-functional product and engineering teams. Proven track record managing large-scale programs with significant budgets and multiple stakeholders. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in engineering , Business, or Technology Management. PMP, PgMP , Scrum, Agile, SAFe , or similar certifications. Experience with IoT, intelligent transportation systems, tolling, mobility technologies, industrial systems, or connected infrastructure. Experience managing third-party technology vendors and strategic partnerships. Familiarity with cybersecurity, data analytics, AI-enabled solutions, and cloud-based platforms. Must be able to demonstrate high computer proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (specifically Word, Excel, Project, PowerPoint) Skills in negotiating large contracts with regional implications Good teamwork skills required Active working attitude required Capability to undertake projects with certain self-sufficiency Capability to work against tight schedules Must be able to proactively multitask, problem solve, and implement innovative processes within a fast-paced environment Work Environment & Physical Demands: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Some travel required; may include air travel within US, Canada and occasionally South America and Europe The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include the ability to adjust focus, as necessary to use a computer. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and sit. Seize the challenge. Move the world together! Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here! Ferrovial is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “ Protected Class ” ), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws. #WeAreFerrovial

title: Principal Solutions Architect - Master Data, Product Data & AI Automation

You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in. Principal Solutions Architect – Master Data, Product Data & AI Automation The Principal Solutions Architect will lead the technical architecture for Ferguson’s master data capabilities, with an immediate focus on product data. This role will set architecture direction, guide solution design, and drive scalable, secure, and sustainable capabilities across data quality, AI-enabled classification and automation, enrichment, and cross-reference solutions. The architect will serve as a senior technical leader across product data and adjacent master data domains, translating sophisticated business and technical needs into solutions that improve data quality, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business value. This is a Principal-level role requiring recognized expertise in Master Data Management, solutions architecture, product data architecture, and practical application of AI and automation. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical depth, enterprise architecture judgment, and the ability to influence business, technology, product, data governance, analytics, and vendor partners across sophisticated initiatives. Location: This role is approved to be either Remote within the United States or Hybrid for associates in Newport News, VA, in accordance with company policy. Duties and Responsibilities: Defines strategic architecture direction for enterprise master data capabilities, with emphasis on product data, data quality, AI automation, enrichment, and cross-reference solutions. Translates complex business, data, AI, and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, roadmaps, implementation guidance, and architecture guardrails. Experience with product data governance operating models, stewardship workflows, data ownership models, and measurable data quality programs. title: Marketplace Operations Manager II
jd_text: Job Title: Marketplace Operations Manager II Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA About the Company Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager II to own visit delivery for a defined set of Wheel's client programs. This is an operator's role for someone who wants day-to-day ownership of critical business outcomes - and can carry that accountability even when some levers live with peer functions. You'll take on the complex, ambiguous problems that come with scaling a fast-growing telehealth marketplace - from stabilizing a roster through demand volatility, to leading cross-functional projects that shape how Marketplace Operations scales next. You will own the visit delivery SLA commitments, program-level consult cost performance, and the roster health for your clients. Separate functions on the team own overall clinician supply forecasting, clinician performance management, and scheduling - freeing you up to optimize their use within your programs. This is a role for someone who wants to run marketplace operations for key clients end-to-end: launching and configuring new client programs, writing the operational playbooks your programs run on, and deploying incentive spend within guardrails - while trusting peer functions to own adjacent responsibilities in order for you to maintain a singular, maniacal focus on client performance. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Program Performance and Delivery - Own marketplace performance outcomes (contractual and otherwise) for your assigned client programs: SLA attainment, program-level clinician pay cost, and roster/staffing health. - Own roster composition and staffing strategy for your programs, building and adjusting rosters to ensure SLA through client growth, churn, and short-term volatility. - Own operational data analytics and reporting for your programs - pulling and interrogating utilization, breach-pattern, and profitability data yourself and turning it into recommendations and actions - Own the operating rhythm and upward performance visibility for your programs: recurring performance reviews of SLA, utilization, and cost that turns into actions. - Partner with the Capacity Planner to understand near-term volatility and how it may affect client demand (ie demand surges, modality changes, etc) and own the operational response for your programs (escalation thresholds, incentive levers, roster mix) to keep the program on track. Cost and Incentives - Optimize program-level clinician pay cost and deploy consult incentive spend within a defined budget. - Own the cost plan for your programs and be accountable to variance - partner with the Director of Marketplace on expected cost-per-consult, and keep your lever costs calibrated so you know how to deploy your incentives appropriately. Real-Time Response and Agent Oversight - Author the real-time escalation and response playbook your programs run on: thresholds, approved corrective actions, escalation triggers. Real-time monitoring and AI agents execute against the playbook you write, and you refine how they act on your programs as their capabilities grow. - Review how the agents act on your programs - audit their decisions for quality, catch policy drift or mistakes early, and feed corrections back into the playbook and the agent logic. You're the human-in-the-loop that keeps automated responses trustworthy on your book. - Partner with clinician management peers to relay clinician performance observations that impact your programs and to identify roster improvements that will drive your client performance. Client Launches and Partnership - Partner with Customer Success as the operational counterpart on the client's commercial relationship - supporting quarterly business reviews and the real-world story behind client performance. - Own launch supply-readiness with Provider Operations and the Capacity Planner - ensuring clinicians are credentialed, licensed, and activated in the right states, at the volume the program needs, before go-live. - Lead new-client implementation - configuration and setup - as part of cross functional onboarding teams, and own expansions for programs you already run. - Support strategic projects across Marketplace Operations as they arise. WHO YOU ARE - An operator with experience working in fast-paced, high-demand environments - someone who digs into the details to find root cause, spots broken or inefficient processes, and builds the fix rather than just flagging the problem. - Experience owning end-to-end operational performance in a marketplace, logistics, or two-sided platform environment (delivery, rideshare, staffing, workforce management) - direct accountability for SLA, throughput, or cost. - Strategic thinker who connects day-to-day program performance to the bigger picture - you can zoom out from a single roster or escalation to spot the pattern worth fixing structurally, and zoom back in to execute it. - A strong cross-functional partner and team player - you know how to work through peer teams and different personalities to drive your program's outcomes, even when you don't own every lever yourself. - Strong data fluency. You pull and interrogate your own SLA, completion, utilization, and cost-to-plan data and drive decisions from it - hands-on with SQL, Looker, and Excel - rather than waiting for someone to translate it for you. - A direct, clear communicator who authors and revises the procedures your programs run on - escalation playbooks, response plans, launch runbooks - rather than only following ones someone else wrote. NICE TO HAVE Don't let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. - Exposure to multi-state licensure, credentialing, or other regulated-workforce dynamics. - Experience launching or configuring new client programs in a marketplace or platform business. - Healthcare, telehealth, or regulated-workforce experience. - Marketplace or platform experience. SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $122,075- $155,000 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Jr. Quality Systems Specialist
jd_text: POSITION OVERVIEW: The Jr. Quality Systems Specialist (JQSS) is responsible for assisting with the implementation and/or usage of assigned internal or external software applications. The JQSS is also responsible for the collection and distribution of data from these systems. KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Perform and document internal audits of existing quality systems and technologies to ensure adherence to regulatory policies and internal guidelines. Identify opportunities for process improvement within quality systems and contribute to developing strategies to enhance efficiency and quality. Complete quality-related transactions, maintain accurate records of inspections and tests, and compile and report on quality data and system performance. Assist in managing key quality system elements, inclusive of Cumulus “Smart Torque” torque management software, Go Canvas, LN, iMonnit Welding Consumable monitoring software, and Intellect. Providing exported data out of each application in a manner that can be used to evaluate business conditions. Making sure software programs continue to work properly after maintenance and testing. Develop business cases for new software applications that best suit the current and future goals of the quality department and departments connected to those processes. Perform training sessions with applicable personnel on usage of software applications. Communicating the status of usage and engagement with these programs within the department. Develop procedures, work instructions and training materials as applicable. Any other tasks assigned by the Director of Quality or the Quality designee. Basic training on quality systems equal or equivalent to ISO 9001:2018. Experience in quality assurance, understanding quality management systems, and familiarity with testing tools and tracking systems. Competent in computer usage with train-the-trainer level ability to utilize numerous systems. Advanced knowledge of manufacturing processes and sequences of operation. Data collection and Exporting Intermediate knowledge of SaaS systems. Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. Ability to work flexibly at different TAS facilities depending on the current department needs. Interpersonal skills to be able to work with others who may be included in utilizing the software program to ensure it works properly. PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS: Knowledge of applicable codes ASME Section VIII, IX, and V ANSI B31.1, 31.3, 31.9 AWS D1.1 NEC/IEC Knowledge of quality management standards: ISO 9001:2015 Advanced knowledge of Manufacturing concepts: Standard Quality Inspection points Manufacturing Assembly and testing Fastener torquing principals. Performs other physical activities including use of fingers, sitting, stooping, bending, crouching, talking, hearing, and performing repetitive motions. Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision necessary to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, and conduct extensive reading. The incumbent will be subject to inside environmental conditions. COMPANY OVERVIEW: Join a team driven to excel in all that we do! When you join TAS, you join a Houston-headquartered company that is part of a large Houston-headquartered publicly traded company, Comfort Systems USA, with a solid reputation built on outstanding value, integrity, and customer focus. We offer our customers and employees the best of both worlds: a small company feel with the resources, talent, process, and international reach of a large company. TAS delivers innovative packaged modular systems that are engineered and manufactured in one of our Houston, TX facilities and utilized in data centers, power, and commercial/industrial utility system applications. TAS has successfully delivered and commissioned over 520 packages to over 33 countries. The company is headquartered in Houston, TX and has five ISO 9001 certified manufacturing facilities in Houston, encompassing 1.2m sq. feet with proximity to major shipping ports and interstate highways. TAS manages all logistics and transportation facilitating accelerated construction at customer’s facilities. TAS’ fastest growing business is the data center market. By applying deep expertise in cooling, thermodynamics, and power, TAS has developed an entire product line that revolutionizes data center delivery. With our tremendous market potential, advanced technological systems, entrepreneurial culture as well as a talented and productive workforce, we continue to set and exceed aggressive market penetration and financial goals. title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience
jd_text: Job Title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience Location: Remote, USA ABOUT THE COMPANY Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting http://www.wheel.com/www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners. You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering. WHAT YOU'LL DO (JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES) Strategy & Vision - Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product - Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making - Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through - Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution - Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur - Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations - Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data - Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration Cross-Functional Leadership - Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders - Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike - Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers WHO YOU ARE (JOB QUALIFICATIONS) - 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process - Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different - Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations - Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production - Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well - Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy - A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast Skills & Competencies - Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work - Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model - Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions - Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design - Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction - Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric - High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $201,700-$301,700 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the final level determined (Staff or Principal), scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Senior Product Manager (Remote)
jd_text: Who We Are Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com. What We Do Product Management defines, promotes and communicates the strategic roadmap for current and future products. Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to gather insights, understand current business process, challenges, and opportunities. Identify potential products and emerging markets; conduct market research; generate product requirements; determine specifications; create product roadmap; conduct competitive assessments and product positioning; and craft marketing strategies/campaigns for new product introduction/launch. Act as primary contact and product evangelist to build awareness, understanding, and user acceptance. Works with customers to develop and prioritize high level product requirements and ensure customer satisfaction and goals are met. Work closely with technology, sales and other cross functional teams to determine plans for product implementation, upgrades and deployments. Participate in creating and driving product positioning and customer messaging. HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE Drive the vision and delivery of innovative new products to keep the business relevant and competitive Develop, define, maintain and communicate the product strategy and roadmap Translate product strategy into detailed requirements Determine and conduct market research to identify user need for new products Prioritize product opportunities using criteria and requirements defined during research Define high level customer requirements for the entire customer experience including product features and functions, target markets, and pricing Understands customer needs, pain points, and opportunities and reflecting by developing impactful positioning and customer messaging. Specifies research needed to obtain market information Develop metrics to assess the success of products and features and determine necessary enhancements Lead and participate in planning meetings and provide advice and guidance on direction of products Collaborate with customers, team members, and outside influencers to ensure a solid and well-rounded understanding of products and developing needs Execute the product roadmap by providing direction to the product development team for product evolution and priorities, ensuring that the experience gained from external market activities, usage analysis, competitive response, and market research is reflected in future product releases Assess market competition by cultivating knowledge of competitor products to identify product gaps, assess and address competitive threats, and gain a competitive edge O ther duties as assigned WHAT YOU’LL BRING Required Education, Experience, Certification/Licensure Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience 7+ years’ directly related experience in product or services development Demonstrated leadership KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs) Strong leadership presence with excellent communication skills and the ability to interact with stakeholders and all levels of management Experience in product development, requirements and risk analysis, pricing, planning, competitive analysis, and financial planning and strategy Knowledge of consumer marketing analytics Strong interpersonal skills with keen ability to explain complex concepts across the organization and to large audiences Sound decision making, creativity, and problem-solving skills Ability to build relationships and ensure cooperation across First American product companies High level of business acumen, strategic agility, ability to develop others, influence outcomes and change, and negotiate for resources Successful track record designing, developing, and executing complex projects Collaboratively engages with leaders to create, identify, and implement solutions to further effectiveness of the business Pay Range: $129,300.00 - $172,300.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. ** Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. ** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements. What We Offer By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.
